WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT s.arcref, p.fundflux, AVG(s.gbsize / s.spanmin) as avg_ratio
  FROM scans s
  JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  WHERE s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin > 0
  GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as overall_avg
  FROM step1
)
SELECT 
  step1.arcref,
  step1.fundflux,
  step1.avg_ratio,
  step1.avg_ratio - step2.overall_avg as difference
FROM step1, step2
WHERE step2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
  AND step1.avg_ratio > step2.overall_avg
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10
